name: dj-battle-platform
description: A dependency-free front-end DJ battle platform designed to open directly in a browser.

scripts.build: node scripts/stamp-sw-version.js && node scripts/stamp-sw-version.js --check && node --check app.js && node --check social.js && node --check connect.js && node --check oct20.js && node --check oct20b.js && node --check studio/beatmatch_lessons.js && node --check embed.js && node scripts/build-light-theme.js --check && node --check api_client.js && node --check submission_upload.js && node --check battle_modes.js && node --check studio/studio_pro.js && node --check studio/studio_recording.js && node --check studio/controller_mapping.js && node --check studio/audio_setup.js && node --check studio/streaming.js && node --check studio/playlist_transfer.js && node --check studio/studio_browser.js && node --check studio/deck_runtime.js && node --check adapters/audio_adapter_example.js && node --check sw.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.webmanifest','utf8'));['offline.html','assets/icon-192.png','assets/icon-512.png','assets/icon-maskable-512.png'].forEach(f=>{if(!require('fs').existsSync(f))throw new Error('missing '+f)})"
